text:
Every morning, my family eats breakfast together. My mother cooks eggs and bread for us. My father likes coffee, but I drink tea with a little sugar. My sister drinks milk because she likes it. We are hungry in the morning, so we eat a big breakfast. Sometimes we eat cheese with our bread too.

At lunch, we eat different food. We often have rice with vegetables and fish or meat. My mother says vegetables are good for our health. After lunch, I like to eat fruit, like an apple or a banana. When I am thirsty, I drink water.

In the evening, we cook dinner together. My father cooks meat, and I help him. We drink water with dinner, not soda. On weekends, we sometimes eat fish. Food is an important part of our family time. We talk and eat together every day. Good food makes us happy and strong.
